Package pt.pa.patterns.command

Class UserActionLogger

java.lang.Object
pt.pa.patterns.observer.Subject
pt.pa.patterns.command.UserActionLogger
All Implemented Interfaces:
Observable
public class UserActionLogger extends Subject
Represents the user action logger Singleton that will store all the user actions and write it on a file. Also represents the Invoker in the Command pattern.
